title: Polaris Key docs
summary: The public landing offers the Help, Developers and member-only Operate doors, a docs search trigger and top Help tasks without hero art.

Only Operate is labelled For console members: developers are public in docs access code.
The title uses the display step and task tiles stack without horizontal scroll on phone.
